evidence.section: Splunk has removed support for versions 1.0 and 1.1 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol
evidence.statement: Heavy Forwarder uses the customer-managed Enterprise package. The 10.6 upgrade notice says the temporary TLS 1.0/1.1 option was removed. The separate 10.6 configuration guide still documents the opt-in. Retain the published conflict and validate TLS 1.2 or 1.3 before upgrading. Do not rely on the legacy setting or infer UF, Cloud-managed or app-owned runtime applicability.
